plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.Adresse e-mail du compte Roborock. Le mo: E-mail address of the Roborock account. The password is never requested: authentication is done via a code received by e-mail.
plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.Port TCP utilisé sur 127.0.0.1 pour dial: TCP port used on 127.0.0.1 to communicate with the daemon. Only change it in case of conflict with another service.
plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.Le niveau de journalisation se règle dan: The logging level is set in the Log block of this page.
plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.Le callback vers Jeedom n'est pas joigna: The callback to Jeedom is not reachable: unsolicited updates will not work.
plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.La ré-authentification n'est jamais auto: Re-authentication is never automatic: if the session expires, request a new login code.
plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.Roborock envoie un code à usage unique à: Roborock sends a one-time code to the registered e-mail address. Save the configuration before requesting a code.
Enter the code received by e-mail.
plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.Authentification réussie, le compte est: Authentication successful, the account is linked.
plugins/jeeroborock/plugin_info/configur.La synchronisation interroge l'inventair: Synchronization queries the Roborock account inventory, whose quota is strictly limited and shared with the mobile app: only run it when you add or remove a robot.

plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.L'adresse e-mail du compte Roborock est: The Roborock account e-mail address is invalid.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.L'adresse e-mail du compte Roborock a ch: The Roborock account e-mail address has changed: the account has been unlinked, request a new login code.

plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Impossible de déterminer l'état du démon: Unable to determine the daemon status, check the plugin log.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.La version %s de python-roborock est plu: Version %s of python-roborock is newer than the major version validated by the plugin (%s): operation is not guaranteed.

plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Réponse inattendue du démon. Consultez l: Unexpected daemon response. Check the daemon log.

The daemon rejected the plugin's request. Check the daemon log.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le démon ne connaît pas l'opération dema: The daemon does not know the requested operation (%s). Restart the daemon after a plugin update.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Erreur interne du démon. Consultez le lo: Internal daemon error. Check the daemon log.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.L'opération n'a pas abouti dans le délai: The operation did not complete within the allotted time.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le compte Roborock n'est pas lié : authe: The Roborock account is not linked: authenticate from the plugin configuration.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Robot inconnu du démon : relancez une sy: Robot unknown to the daemon: run a device synchronization again.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le robot est hors ligne : il ne répond p: The robot is offline: it is not responding to the Roborock cloud.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Session Roborock expirée : une nouvelle: Roborock session expired: a new authentication by e-mail code is required.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Aucune demande de code en cours (le démo: No code request in progress (the daemon may have restarted): request a new code.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Trop de demandes de code de connexion :: Too many login code requests: wait a few minutes before trying again.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.L'adresse e-mail du compte Roborock est: The Roborock account e-mail address is invalid.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Aucun compte Roborock ne correspond à ce: No Roborock account matches this e-mail address.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Les conditions d'utilisation Roborock n': The Roborock terms of use have not been accepted: open the Roborock mobile app to accept them.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Les conditions d'utilisation Roborock on: The Roborock terms of use have changed: open the Roborock mobile app to accept them again.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Quota d'appels Roborock atteint : patien: Roborock call quota reached: wait before trying again. This quota is shared with the Roborock mobile app.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le cloud Roborock a refusé la demande (t: The Roborock cloud rejected the request (too many requests): wait before trying again.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le cloud Roborock est injoignable : véri: The Roborock cloud is unreachable: check Jeedom's Internet access.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Impossible de déterminer le serveur Robo: Unable to determine the Roborock server for this account.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le cloud Roborock a rejeté la demande (p: The Roborock cloud rejected the request (missing parameters). Check the daemon log.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Réponse incompréhensible du cloud Roboro: Unintelligible response from the Roborock cloud. Check the daemon log.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.La connexion avec le cloud Roborock ou l: The connection with the Roborock cloud or the robot failed.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le cloud Roborock ou le robot n'a pas ré: The Roborock cloud or the robot did not respond within the allotted time.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Plusieurs tentatives de communication on: Several communication attempts failed: try again later.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le robot est occupé : il ne peut pas tra: The robot is busy: it cannot process this request now.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le robot a refusé l'action dans son état: The robot refused the action in its current state.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le robot signale une erreur : consultez: The robot is reporting an error: check its status in the Roborock app.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le robot a signalé une erreur en exécuta: The robot reported an error while executing the command.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Cette fonction n'est pas disponible sur: This feature is not available on this robot model.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le robot ne reconnaît pas cette commande: The robot does not recognize this command.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Erreur Roborock non identifiée. Consulte: Unidentified Roborock error. Check the daemon log.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Cet usage a été supprimé dans l'applicat: This routine has been deleted in the Roborock app: delete this command or run a routine synchronization again.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Le cloud Roborock n'a pas pu exécuter ce: The Roborock cloud could not run this routine: it may be missing or outdated. Run a routine synchronization again.
plugins/jeeroborock/core/class/jeeroboro.Une synchronisation des usages vient d'ê: A routine synchronization has just been performed: wait a minute before trying again.

plugins/jeeroborock/core/ajax/jeeroboroc.Le compte Roborock n'est pas lié : deman: The Roborock account is not linked: request a login code to authenticate the account.

plugins/jeeroborock/core/ajax/jeeroboroc.Aucun robot compatible n'a été trouvé su: No compatible robot was found on this Roborock account.
